BP to Develop Venezuelan Gas Field Amid Political Transition

British energy giant BP has been awarded a license to develop the offshore Loran gas field in Venezuela. This marks a significant return for the company and signals a broader reopening of Venezuela's energy sector to foreign investment following the departure of Nicolás Maduro. BP will partner with state-backed firms from the UAE and Qatar, including Adnoc's XRG. Concurrently, Venezuela released 131 prisoners as transition talks progress in the country.
